speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
text: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien): Mr Speaker, this being the first Sitting of the year, may I wish you "Happy New Year", and through you, wish everyone in the Chamber, as well as all supporting staff of Parliament, an equally prosperous and happy new year.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: And allow me to also take this opportunity to wish everyone a happy and healthy 2024.
